summary:
**Project Summary: SKY MINDS – Voices from the Silent Explorers**

Our team, SKY MINDS (Diana, Erica, Davion, and Caeser from SMK Merbau Miri), developed an educational video that brings NASA's space hardware to life through storytelling. The video introduces school-age space enthusiasts to famous space exploration equipment left on the Moon, Mars, and deep space, including rovers, landers, and probes that helped scientists make important discoveries about our solar system.

The project addresses the challenge by transforming scientific information into a simple, engaging narrative that is easy for young audiences to understand. By combining visuals, narration, and mission highlights, the video explains the purpose of these machines, their achievements, and how some continue to contribute to science today.

This project is important because it inspires curiosity about space exploration, encourages interest in STEM subjects, and helps students appreciate the lasting impact of NASA's missions. Through an accessible and creative format, we connect young learners with the history and future of space discovery.
details:
Project Details: SKY MINDS – Voices from the Silent Explorers

What does the project do and how does it work?

SKY MINDS created a 30-second educational video that tells the story of NASA's exploration hardware left across the solar system. The video uses narration, space-themed visuals, text animations, and mission images to introduce viewers to iconic equipment such as lunar landers, Mars rovers, and deep-space probes. The story follows these "silent explorers" and explains how they helped scientists learn about the Moon, Mars, and the wider universe.

Benefits of the Project

  • Makes space science easier and more exciting for young learners.
  • Encourages curiosity about astronomy, engineering, and technology.
  • Presents complex scientific information in a short, engaging format.
  • Helps students understand the accomplishments and legacy of NASA's missions.

Intended Impact

The project aims to inspire school-age students to explore STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) fields and develop a greater appreciation for space exploration. By presenting scientific achievements through storytelling, the video helps learners connect emotionally with the machines that expanded human knowledge beyond Earth.

Tools, Hardware, Software, and Technologies Used

  • Canva for video design and editing.
  • AI-assisted content generation for script development and storytelling.
  • Presentation and video production tools for transitions, visual effects, and subtitles.
  • Computer/laptop for editing and project development.

Creativity and Innovation

Our project creatively gives a "voice" to NASA's space hardware, allowing viewers to imagine each spacecraft sharing its own story. Instead of presenting facts alone, we transformed scientific missions into a narrative adventure that is memorable, engaging, and age-appropriate.

Factors Considered by the Team

During development, our team considered:

  • Age appropriateness for school-age audiences.
  • Simple and clear language for easy understanding.
  • Accurate scientific content.
  • Engaging visuals and storytelling.
  • Short runtime to maintain audience attention.
  • Accessibility through captions and readable text.

Team Information

Group Name: SKY MINDS

School: SMK Merbau Miri

Team Members: Diana, Erica, Davion, and Caeser

Through this project, SKY MINDS demonstrates how storytelling can transform scientific history into an inspiring learning experience for the next generation of space explorers.
